title: New Shape Dies for Your Clicker Press – Watch Us Make Custom Hatch Patches!
summary: Check out our new shape dies for leather clicker presses – perfect for making custom leather patches and tags. Watch the video demo creating custom hatch patches!
body_markdown:
We're excited to drop a fresh batch of **custom shape dies for your leather clicker press** ! Whether you're crafting leather patches, custom tags, or one-of-a-kind accessories, these dies are designed to make your workflow faster, cleaner, and more fun.


To show them in action, we put together a quick video where we press out a few **custom hatch patches** using one of our new dies.


**Ready to upgrade your shop?[SHOP ALL MATERIALS HERE](https://tandyleather.com/products/tandypro-japanese-clicker-press-die)**


These dies are perfect for anyone working with:


-


Leather patch making


-


Hat and cap decoration


-


Custom branding tags


-


Small-batch production or hobby leatherwork


Made from hardened steel and built to last, our dies give clean cuts with minimal effort – just load them into your clicker press and go. And yes, we offer **custom shapes** if you're after something totally unique!


Got an idea for a custom die? Drop us a message – we love helping makers bring their ideas to life.
